title: net.input_resent_redundant
description: M8B § Acceptance 'Redundant-input encoding recovers from single-datagram loss'. Emitted by the server when an input tick that would otherwise have stalled the rollback queue is recovered from a redundant-input tail piggybacked on a later datagram. NOT cosmetic (recovery is sim-relevant evidence).

recovered_tick.description: The tick whose datagram was dropped + recovered from a redundant tail.

carrier_tick.description: The tick of the datagram whose redundant tail carried the recovered input.

window_ticks.description: Configured redundant-input window. Default 3 per M8B § Notes.
